title: API-Surface Coverage Manifest
description: Per-plugin API-surface coverage. Counts are MEASURED by scripts/measure-api-surface.mts and published as upper bounds; this file holds only what a measurement cannot produce — the prose description of each surface, whether its denominator has been curated to the consumer-callable API, and the outOfScope judgements with their reasons. A count here is rejected by the audit.

target_floor_pct.description: Coverage floor below which a plugin's row fails the strict audit. Default 60.

notEnumerable.description: Plugins with no enumerable module surface — they analyse plain JS/TS or the web platform. Recorded by name because 'not applicable' is a measurement, not silence.

outOfScope.description: APIs on the target surface that are deliberately not rule targets because they are not security sinks under this plugin's threat model. Subtracted from the coverage denominator. NOT a place to park unclosed gaps: the audit rejects reasons that argue from rarity ('niche', 'rare', 'low-traffic') rather than threat model.

reason.description: Why this API cannot be misused in a way this plugin should catch. Must argue threat model, not frequency.

denominatorTrust.description: 'curated' means the denominator is the consumer-callable API a rule could act on; the 60% floor applies. 'raw' means it is still the whole module enumeration, which can be wrong in either direction — @aws-sdk/client-lambda enumerates the Lambda control plane, better-sqlite3 reads as one callable — and the floor does not apply.

denominatorNote.description: What the denominator is and why it can be trusted. 'curated' without an argument is an assertion, and the audit rejects it.
